# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.8.4

Version 1.8.4 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.8.3

**The full touch mode's icons, drawn again.** They were flat pictograms of a few lines and boxes. Every one is now a
little sticker in the game's mood: round, chunky parts inside one dark brown outline, in warm colours, on a cream
button with a tan rim that sinks onto its shadow when pressed (and turns green when it is on). Still drawn from
shapes by the port itself; nothing is taken from the game's pictures.

- The icons: the menu (a list with leaves), save (a diary with a leaf on its cover, where an arrow into a tray was),
  the gamepad, the pockets (a satchel with a leaf clasp), the map (folded, a river and a pin), the furniture mode's
  armchair, close and done, the turning arrows, "into the pockets", the room's camera, zoom and light, the NES game's
  door, the menus' keys (arrows, play, backspace, labels).
- The tools on the strip: an open hand, the net, the axe, the shovel, the rod, an umbrella, a balloon, a pinwheel, a
  fan, a flower, a party popper, a present for anything else; the golden tools in gold.
- The tool strip is a wooden board with its arrows; the furniture mode's hint is a bubble with the same outline; the
  upright answer buttons have the outline and rim too, and a leaf marks the one the cursor is on.

- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.5.2's to v1.8.3's: they can be in the same room. 32-bit and 64-bit
  players can play together, whatever graphics API each uses.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.4-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 (Windows 10+) |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.4-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.4-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan 1.0 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.4-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a); Vulkan on Android 7.0+ |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- Every icon on one sheet (`PC_TOUCH_ICON_SHEET=1`), and in the game by script: the HUD with the tool strip on
  1280x720, the upright HUD, a talk's answer buttons and the furniture mode on 720x1560.
- The fifteen touch checks, on v1.8.3's release and on this version: all log the same (the same taps do the same
  things); their screenshots differ only where the icons are shown.
- The 43 scripted scenarios run for every release give the same screenshots, logged positions and saves on v1.7.0 and
  on this version, touch off.
- All unit tests pass. No decomp change.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.8.4, versionCode 10804); the four
  files hold the same files as v1.8.3's.

## Known limitations

- Checked with touches given by script on the desktop, not yet on a phone.
- The limitations of v1.8.3 remain (see the [v1.8.3 notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.8.3)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
